central_finding: The CURRENT deployed V2 SVM (94.12%) does not clearly beat the trivial static word-count<=4 baseline (100.00%) on this n=85 evaluation set. This reproduces the previously-reported central finding numerically, now independently re-verified live in this session rather than taken on faith. Note however that the deployed model changed (gap-fill retrain) since whatever prior session first computed this comparison -- the PRE_GAPFIX model performed considerably worse (70.59%), so this 94.12% figure describes the CURRENT model, not necessarily the same model instance the original finding was about.
caveat: This is a small (n=85), non-blind evaluation set that has not been proven independent of decisions made about the labeling guidelines. It should not be treated as a definitive final-test result.
